summary: Iteration-5 full test of the new payment-methods / Accounts feature. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py (12 pytest cases) -> 11 PASSED / 1 FAILED. Covered default seeding of Cash/Bank Transfer/Card / ATM with computed balance, /api/payments/summary total consistency, owner-only CRUD + staff 403 on create/update/delete, delete blocked (400) while entries exist and succeeding once empty, validation (422 on bad type / amount<=0 / bad direction, 404 unknown method), manual deposit+withdrawal with running balance_after and statement math (opening 500 + 200 in - 75.5 out = 624.5), invoice mark-paid logging an IN entry equal to invoice total + 400 on re-mark + 404 on unknown method (invoice stays draft) + entry undeletable (400), PO receive logging an OUT entry equal to PO total, inventory qty/cost update, staff 403, duplicate receive 400, and cash-register exposing payment_method_name. Frontend (Playwright, owner + staff): /accounts renders 3 default cards + grand total, new method 'QA Wise Business' (bank, opening 250) created and card appears, deposit 100 -> balance 350 and grand total refreshed, statement table with period-opening/total-in/total-out/closing boxes + print/PDF buttons + entry row with running balance, invoice 'Paid' dialog with method select -> invoice becomes Paid, PO 'Receive' dialog with method select -> PO becomes Received (Cash 560 -> 562 after +20 invoice / -18 PO, arithmetic correct), cash-register shows 'By payment method' section and payment-method column, sidebar nav-accounts present between Cash Register and Reminders, staff sees read-only Accounts (no New method / edit / toggle / delete). Zero console errors and zero 4xx/5xx responses in all UI runs. Logo /logo-shawish.png serves 200 (40851 bytes) and settings.logo_url points at it. One real backend defect found (PO payment method stripped from API response). All QA/TEST data cleaned up.

minor.issue: BUG: payment_method_id / payment_method_name are written to db.purchase_orders by receive_po but the PurchaseOrder Pydantic model has no such fields, so response_model=List[PurchaseOrder] strips them. Verified in Mongo: PO doc has payment_method_name='Bank Transfer' while the API returns no such key -> UI can never show which account paid a PO. Fix: add payment_method_id/payment_method_name Optional fields to PurchaseOrder (Invoice model already has them).

payment_method_id is optional; when omitted (UI offers an explicit 'no method' option) the document is marked paid/received with NO ledger entry, so account balances silently diverge from revenue. If that is not intended, make the method mandatory or flag such documents as 'unallocated'.

Inventory/transaction writes happen BEFORE the payment_method validation; a bad payment_method_id returns 404 after stock has already been incremented (partial write, no rollback). Validate the method first.
_pm_balance runs one full find() per method (N+1, up to 20000 docs each). Fine now, but replace with a single $group aggregation before the ledger grows.
updates dict drops None values, which also makes it impossible to clear 'note' back to null; active=false works correctly (verified). Low impact.

issues: FROM/TO filters use native <input type=date> pickers instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere (same nit as iteration 4 Reports tab).
The exported report headers are still ['Time','Invoice','Customer','Total'] — the new payment-method column present in the on-screen table is missing from the PDF/print output.
Statement card only renders after a method card is clicked; there is no hint/empty-state prompting the user to pick an account (minor discoverability).

action_items: Add payment_method_id / payment_method_name Optional fields to the PurchaseOrder model so the received PO's payment account survives response serialization (and optionally show it as a column on /purchase-orders).
Decide whether payment_method is mandatory on mark-paid / receive; today the 'no method' choice silently skips the ledger entry.
Move the payment-method existence check in receive_po above the inventory/transaction writes to avoid partial receives on a bad method id.

Optional polish: include the payment-method column in the Cash Register PDF/print export; swap the Accounts statement native date inputs for the shadcn Calendar; replace the per-method balance find() with a single aggregation.
critical_code_review_comments: Statement math is correct: period_opening only adds pre-range entries when `start` is supplied; without start it equals opening_balance. Verified numerically.
Ledger immutability is enforced: DELETE /api/payment-entries rejects reference_type in (invoice, po, repair) with 400 and is owner-only — verified for both invoice and PO entries.

Staff role can read every account balance and the grand total, and can also POST /api/payment-entries (only method CRUD is owner-gated). Confirm this is the intended privacy/authorisation model for a garage with mechanics.

server.py is now ~1533 lines and re-includes the api_router at the bottom (app.router.routes filtered then re-added) — split payments/invoices/POs into APIRouter modules; the route-stripping hack is fragile.
Payment entries carry no soft-delete/void path, so a wrongly-paid invoice cannot be corrected without direct DB access (only manual/opening entries are deletable).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (accounts CRUD, entry, statement, invoice paid dialog, PO receive dialog, cash register breakdown, nav, staff read-only)

rca_of_the_issue: PO payment method missing from API: receive_po persists payment_method_id/payment_method_name via $set, but GET /api/purchase-orders declares response_model=List[PurchaseOrder] and the PurchaseOrder model (server.py:534) does not declare those fields, so FastAPI filters them out of the serialized response. Confirmed by reading the Mongo doc directly (payment_method_name='Bank Transfer') while the HTTP response omits the key.
